summary: Printer diagnostics and repair across Linux, macOS and Windows

delivery.outcome: `fixos printers` diagnoses CUPS and Windows spooler print queues (unresolvable printer host name, unreachable port, paused queue, stuck jobs, generic driver on a driverless printer, stopped service), relocates a printer by the MAC embedded in its NetBIOS name, proposes or applies repair commands and can send a verified test page; the plugin also runs in quickfix.
nonGoals: No change to other plugins or to quickfix execution logic.
No unbounded network scanning: the optional sweep touches at most the local /24 on TCP 631.

architecture.decision: Add a built-in DiagnosticPlugin 'printers' with injectable command runner, resolver and port probe; CUPS backend via lpstat/lpoptions/ipptool, Windows backend via PowerShell PrintManagement; repairs are expressed as Finding.command so both quickfix and the new `fixos printers --fix` command reuse them.

validation.evidence: unit tests with mocked CUPS/Windows outputs
live run on a Brother HL-L5200DW on LAN
